name: Rezi
shortDescription: AI resume builder that scores a resume and targets keywords. Pro is $29 a month.
longDescription: Rezi's homepage says it builds a resume, scores it section by section, and pulls missing keywords from a pasted job description. The same page lists a Free plan at $0 a month for one resume, limited AI tools, and up to three PDF downloads, and Pro at $29 a month.
pricingNotes: The homepage lists Free at $0 a month for one resume and three PDF downloads, and Pro at $29 a month.
freeTierNotes: One resume, limited AI tools, and up to three PDF downloads. No card required to begin.
bestFor: Building a resume and scoring it against a job description
strength: Rezi's homepage says it builds a resume, scores it, and pulls missing keywords from a pasted job description.
weakness: The Free plan allows one resume and three PDF downloads, and Pro is $29 a month.

useCaseFit.write-resume: Builds a resume, scores the sections, and pulls keywords from a job description.
